$comment: Hand-authored input for scripts/sync-skills.ts. `upstreamCategories` names the cmsis-skills categories that are vendored; `installed` names the only skills the extension installs (cmsis-help), every other catalog entry is a unit of the knowledge index. `bundled` names the extension's own skills, authored in skills/. Workflow lines become the Typical workflow section of the generated router SKILL.md. Run `npm run skills:sync -- --offline` after an edit.

categories.label: CMSIS project setup
categories.shortDescription: Create, extend or retarget CMSIS csolution and Zephyr projects
categories.description: Set up and extend CMSIS csolution projects and Zephyr-based CMSIS solutions: verify the CMSIS-Toolbox, CMake, Ninja and compiler environment or a Zephyr west workspace; resolve a fuzzy board or device name to its exact CMSIS identity and BSP/DFP, or to its Zephyr board target; add a verified target to an existing *.csolution.yml; find compatible packaged board layers; or create an initial west-integrated CMSIS Zephyr Blinky solution. Use when the user wants to create, extend or retarget a csolution, check their build tools, or identify board, device and pack identifiers; it routes to the specialised project procedures of the knowledge index. Not for debugging a running target (cmsis-debug-live) or for PDSC authoring (cmsis-pack).
workflow: No folder open or no solution yet: `/cmsis-bootstrap` first; it opens or creates the project folder and hands over to `$start-cmsis-project`, which writes a minimal project (CMSIS CORE, the DFP's startup, a bare `main`; Arm Compiler 6 unless the user prefers another compiler) or copies an example of the board's pack, then builds it with `cmsis_action build`.
`$check-cmsis-environment` (or `$check-zephyr-environment`) to confirm the toolchain before anything is created or built.
`$identify-cmsis-board-support` (or `$identify-zephyr-board`) to resolve the hardware to exactly one verified identity and its BSP/DFP.
`$add-cmsis-target` to extend the solution, then `$identify-cmsis-board-layer` for a packaged board layer — or `$start-zephyr-project` for a new west-integrated solution.

`$add-board-layer` when no packaged layer fits: interview for the few open decisions, then author Board.clayer.yml with its startup, stdio and memory files — or integrate the DFP's configuration generator — and build to green.
`$cmsis-debugger-setup` once the solution builds: set the debug adapter of the target set, let the CMSIS Solution extension write launch.json, and verify Load & Debug on the target.
